# oodle_genai_code_library (Resource)

A shared Python module that 'code' eval templates import as `shared.<name>`, so that helper code is written once. Each change of source_code adds a version; a template can pin the version it runs in its library_pins. The API refuses to delete a library while a template or another library imports it. Requires an enterprise plan and the code evaluator feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A shared Python module. Code templates import it as
# `shared.house_style`. Each change of source_code adds a version.
resource "oodle_genai_code_library" "house_style" {
  name        = "house_style"
  description = "Checks replies against the support style guide."

  source_code = <<-EOT
    from oodle_eval.v1 import text

    def banned_phrases_found(reply, phrases):
        lower = text.normalize(reply)
        return [p for p in phrases if text.normalize(p) in lower]
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Module name the code imports, as `shared.<name>`, for example `from shared.<name> import f`. A lower-case letter followed by at most 63 lower-case letters, digits and underscores; not a Python keyword, 'oodle_eval' or 'shared'. Cannot be changed after creation, because the code that imports the library names it.
- `source_code` (String) Python source of the module, at most 256 KB.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the library provides.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the code library.
- `version` (Number) Latest version of the library. Each change of source_code adds one. Reference it from a template's library_pins to pin the version the template runs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Code libraries are imported by id.
terraform import oodle_genai_code_library.house_style 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
